points.title: 童年启蒙
points.description: 普罗科菲耶夫出生于俄罗斯帝国叶卡捷琳诺斯拉夫省松佐夫卡的一个富裕农庄家庭。父亲是庄园管理员，母亲是受过良好教育的农妇。母亲成为他最早的钢琴教师，发现了他非凡的音乐天赋。在这个偏远的农庄环境中，普罗科菲耶夫开始接触音乐，并展现出惊人的即兴创作能力。这段乡村生活培养了他对自然的热爱，这种情感后来融入了他的许多作品中，如《彼得与狼》中的自然描写。
points.descriptionEn: Prokofiev was born in Sontsovka, a remote estate in the Russian Empire, to a wealthy family. His mother, a well-educated woman, became his first piano teacher and discovered his extraordinary musical talent. In this rural setting, Prokofiev was exposed to music and demonstrated remarkable improvisational skills. This countryside upbringing fostered his love for nature, which later permeated many of his works, such as the nature depictions in 'Peter and the Wolf'.

points.title: 音乐学院深造
points.description: 13岁时，普罗科菲耶夫进入圣彼得堡音乐学院，师从里姆斯基-科萨科夫、利亚多夫等著名作曲家。在这里，他发展了自己独特的音乐风格，将俄罗斯传统与先锋派元素相结合。他的毕业作品《第一钢琴协奏曲》因其大胆的创新和技巧性而引起轰动。同时期，他创作了第一部歌剧《赌徒》，展现了早期对戏剧音乐的探索。这段学习经历奠定了他作为20世纪最具创新精神作曲家之一的地位。
points.descriptionEn: At age 13, Prokofiev entered the Saint Petersburg Conservatory, studying under renowned composers like Rimsky-Korsakov and Lyadov. Here, he developed his unique musical style, combining Russian traditions with avant-garde elements. His graduation work, 'First Piano Concerto', caused a sensation due to its bold innovations and technical demands. During this period, he also composed his first opera, 'The Gambler', demonstrating early explorations in dramatic music. This educational period established him as one of the most innovative composers of the 20th century.

points.title: 西方成名期
points.description: 1918年，俄国革命后，普罗科菲耶夫离开苏联，先前往美国，后定居巴黎。在西方，他作为钢琴家和作曲家获得了国际声誉。这一时期创作了《第三钢琴协奏曲》、《古典交响曲》等重要作品，展现了他对古典形式的现代诠释。他与佳吉列夫合作创作了芭蕾舞剧《钢铁的步伐》、《浪子回头》和《罗密欧与朱丽叶》。这段经历丰富了他的创作视野，使他能够接触到西方现代艺术潮流，同时也加深了他对俄罗斯传统的反思。
points.descriptionEn: Following the Russian Revolution, Prokofiev left the Soviet Union in 1918, first traveling to the United States and then settling in Paris. In the West, he gained international reputation as both pianist and composer. During this period, he composed major works like the 'Third Piano Concerto' and 'Classical Symphony', showcasing his modern interpretations of classical forms. He collaborated with Diaghilev on ballets including 'The Steel Step', 'The Prodigal Son', and 'Romeo and Juliet'. This experience broadened his creative perspective and deepened his reflection on Russian traditions.

points.title: 苏联回归
points.description: 1936年，普罗科菲耶夫决定返回苏联，期望在祖国获得更稳定的创作环境。然而，他回国不久后，苏联文化政策开始收紧，现代主义音乐受到批判。这一时期他创作了著名的儿童作品《彼得与狼》和《古典交响曲》的修订版，同时也开始创作更符合官方要求的作品。他的《第五钢琴协奏曲》和《第七钢琴奏鸣曲》等作品展现了他在艺术追求与政治现实之间的平衡尝试。这一阶段标志着他创作风格的转变，从先锋派向更易被接受的风格过渡。
points.descriptionEn: In 1936, Prokofiev decided to return to the Soviet Union, hoping for a more stable creative environment in his homeland. However, shortly after his return, Soviet cultural policies tightened, and modernist music faced criticism. During this period, he created famous children's works like 'Peter and the Wolf' and a revised version of the 'Classical Symphony', while also beginning to compose works more aligned with official requirements. His 'Fifth Piano Concerto' and 'Seventh Piano Sonata' demonstrate his attempts to balance artistic pursuits with political realities. This phase marked a shift in his compositional style, transitioning from avant-garde to more accessible forms.

points.title: 战争岁月
points.description: 第二次世界大战期间，普罗科菲耶夫被疏散到高加索地区，后来又迁往哈萨克斯坦的阿拉木图。战争期间，他的创作转向更严肃和爱国主义的主题。他创作了著名的《第五交响曲》，这部作品在1945年首演时获得了巨大成功，被斯大林授予斯大林奖。同时，他还完成了《战争与和平》的早期创作。这段战争经历深刻影响了他的音乐创作，使他的作品增添了更多的悲剧性和英雄主义色彩，同时也体现了他对祖国命运的深切关怀。
points.descriptionEn: During World War II, Prokofiev was evacuated to the Caucasus region and later moved to Almaty in Kazakhstan. The war redirected his compositions toward more serious and patriotic themes. He created his famous 'Fifth Symphony', which achieved great success at its 1945 premiere and earned him the Stalin Prize. He also began work on 'War and Peace'. This wartime experience profoundly influenced his music, adding more tragic and heroic elements to his compositions while demonstrating his deep concern for his homeland's fate.

points.title: 晚年创作
points.description: 战争结束后，普罗科菲耶夫回到莫斯科，进入创作生涯的最后阶段。尽管健康状况逐渐恶化，他仍然创作了一系列重要作品，包括《第七交响曲》、《小提琴协奏曲》和《大提琴奏鸣曲》。他完成了歌剧《战争与和平》和《故事员》。1953年，在同一天去世的还有斯大林，这使得他的葬礼几乎未被媒体报道。普罗科菲耶夫的晚年作品融合了他一生的创作经验，既有古典主义的严谨，又有现代主义的创新，同时融入了俄罗斯民族音乐的元素，形成了独特的个人风格。
points.descriptionEn: After the war, Prokofiev returned to Moscow, entering the final phase of his creative career. Despite declining health, he produced a series of important works, including the 'Seventh Symphony', 'Violin Concerto', and 'Cello Sonata'. He completed the operas 'War and Peace' and 'The Storyteller'. In 1953, he died on the same day as Stalin, causing his funeral to receive little media attention. His late works integrated a lifetime of creative experience, combining classical rigor with modernist innovation while incorporating elements of Russian folk music, forming a unique personal style.

supporter.zh: 普罗科菲耶夫是20世纪最伟大的作曲家之一，他成功地将俄罗斯音乐传统与现代主义创新相结合。他的作品以其独特的旋律、和声与节奏而著称，既有古典主义的清晰结构，又包含大胆的和声语言。作为钢琴家，他演奏自己的作品时展现出非凡的技巧与表现力。他的儿童音乐作品如《彼得与狼》普及了古典音乐教育，而他的芭蕾舞剧和歌剧则为俄罗斯音乐剧传统做出了重要贡献。普罗科菲耶夫的音乐遗产跨越了政治界限，至今仍在全球范围内广泛演出和欣赏。
supporter.en: Prokofiev is regarded as one of the greatest composers of the 20th century, successfully combining Russian musical traditions with modernist innovation. His works are distinguished by their unique melodies, harmonies, and rhythms, featuring both classical clarity and bold harmonic language. As a pianist, he demonstrated extraordinary technique and expressiveness in performing his own works. His children's music, such as 'Peter and the Wolf', has popularized classical music education, while his ballets and operas have made significant contributions to the Russian theatrical music tradition. Prokofiev's musical legacy transcends political boundaries and continues to be widely performed and appreciated globally.

critic.zh: 批评者认为普罗科菲耶夫在苏联时期的创作受到了政治压力的严重影响，导致他后期作品缺乏早期的创新精神。一些评论家指出，他在斯大林统治下的妥协使他失去了艺术独立性，作品变得更加保守和公式化。此外，他的音乐虽然技巧精湛，但有时被认为缺乏情感深度，过于依赖表面效果。还有人批评他在西方和苏联之间的摇摆不定，缺乏坚定的政治立场，这使得他的艺术生涯呈现出某种矛盾性。这些批评者认为，普罗科菲耶夫未能完全实现早期展现的巨大潜力。
critic.en: Critics argue that Prokofiev's work during his Soviet period was significantly affected by political pressure, leading to a loss of the innovative spirit of his early compositions. Some commentators suggest that his compromises under Stalin's rule compromised his artistic independence, making his later works more conservative and formulaic. Additionally, while technically brilliant, his music is sometimes criticized for lacking emotional depth and relying too heavily on surface effects. Others have criticized his wavering between the West and the Soviet Union, lacking a firm political stance, which they see as creating contradictions in his artistic career. These critics believe Prokofiev failed to fully realize the immense potential demonstrated in his early work.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，普罗科菲耶夫被定义为一位跨越政治与文化边界的音乐巨匠。他的作品体现了20世纪音乐发展的复杂性，既有对传统的继承，又有对现代性的探索。在冷战背景下，他的音乐成为东西方文化交流的桥梁，既在苏联被官方认可，又在西方获得艺术成就的肯定。流行文化中，他的《彼得与狼》成为儿童音乐教育的经典，《罗密欧与朱丽叶》芭蕾舞曲被广泛用于电影和电视。历史学界普遍认为，普罗科菲耶夫的生涯反映了艺术家在极权主义环境中的生存策略，他的音乐遗产体现了个人创造力与历史环境的复杂互动。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Prokofiev is defined as a musical giant who transcended political and cultural boundaries. His works embody the complexity of 20th-century musical development, showing both inheritance of tradition and exploration of modernity. Against the backdrop of the Cold War, his music became a bridge for East-West cultural exchange, receiving official recognition in the Soviet Union while achieving artistic acclaim in the West. In popular culture, 'Peter and the Wolf' has become a classic in children's music education, and his 'Romeo and Juliet' ballet music is widely used in film and television. Historiography generally views Prokofiev's career as reflecting the survival strategies of artists under totalitarianism, with his musical legacy representing the complex interplay between individual creativity and historical circumstances.

self.zh: 音乐应该首先悦耳，其次才表达思想。
self.en: Music should first and foremost be pleasing to the ear, and only secondarily express ideas.

others.zh: 普罗科菲耶夫的音乐就像一个精致的俄罗斯玩偶，外表简单朴素，但打开后却展现出无限复杂和美丽。
others.en: Prokofiev's music is like a delicate Russian doll—simple and unassuming on the outside, but infinitely complex and beautiful when opened.
